en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural European village. In the foreground is a sizeable two‑storey building with a sign indicating it is a restaurant and hotel dedicated to St. Romanus. A dirt road curves past the building toward the background where scattered houses, fields, and a church with a tall spire are visible. Handwritten red numbers and printed captions appear on the front.
